verdict.rationale: Email sync is a fair axis for a CRM, but the evidence pack has nothing on connecting Gmail or Outlook, two-way email sync, or automatic logging of emails to records. The only email-related items are generic REST APIs (developer building blocks) and a client-script 'background mail trigger', which is an adjacent outbound feature, not mailbox sync.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records
